newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Communications Q1 net loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Communications Q1 net loss narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: First Call mean estimate for Q1 was a loss of $0.16 a share.
Q1 1997 operating cash flow was $738 million, up from $533 million in Q1 1996. Q1 1997 Operating income was $349 million, up from $172 million in Q1 1996.

For TCI Group, the company reported revenue of $1.791 billion, up from $1.469 billion in the year-ago quarter. TCI Group's 1997 Q1 net loss was $74 million, or $0.12 per share, down from a net loss of $136 million, or $0.22 per share in the 1996 quarter.

For Liberty Media Group, the company reported revenues of $59.4 million, down from $420.6 million in the 1996 first quarter. Liberty Media had a net profit of 15.6 million, or $0.06 a share, compared to a profit of $14.8 million, or $0.06 a share in the 1996 quarter.
Full company name is Tele-Communications Inc.
